description: This script generates HTML documentation for Spark SQL functions, including tables of function signatures and examples, by querying JVM-based Spark SQL utils and executing sample queries.

classes.name: ExpressionInfo
classes.description: Named tuple to hold information about SQL expressions, including name, usage, examples, and group.

methods.name: _list_grouped_function_infos
methods.description: Retrieves and groups built-in Spark SQL function info from JVM, sorting by name within each group.

methods.name: _make_pretty_usage
methods.description: Formats function usage info into an HTML table for documentation.

methods.name: _make_pretty_examples
methods.description: Generates formatted HTML examples for functions by executing sample queries.

methods.name: generate_functions_table_html
methods.description: Creates HTML files listing functions and their signatures.

methods.name: generate_functions_examples_html
methods.description: Creates HTML files with examples of function usage by executing sample queries.
